value.rationale: The positive-shift Carmichael/Korselt condition is a natural named arithmetic family. Fixed-smallest-prime finiteness for every p, an explicit divisor-based algorithm and complete p=3 and p=5 fibers distinguish the structural result from a routine table extension. The theorem gives mathematically motivated exact knowledge without claiming global infinitude or downstream results.
